items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So our road manager had a little Jewish road manager, Sam Flashnick (PHONETIC).

ctx.x: So I say to Duke, "What's the matter, man?" He say, "This guy's trying to give me a hard time." Now, they still don't know Owney Madden (PHONETIC) is our representative -- boss. I say, "Get on the phone, call this number." We had to get a private number. They call this number. So Petrillo say, "Who you calling?" I say, "The man who owns our band." And he knew -- he knew the number, you know.

So man, he turn around and look at me. "Don't call it." I say, "Oh, yeah, let me call him up." "No." "Yeah, I'd rather call this." I say, "You all are interfering with my living. I've got to call this." So our road manager had a little Jewish road manager, Sam Flashnick (PHONETIC). He called the number. So Owney answered; said, "Put him on." What he said
I never know but when he got through talking to this cat, this cat was this small.
